newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOL puts building up for sale.
newsitem.headline: UOL puts building up for sale.

text.p: United Overseas Land Ltd (UOL), the property arm of United Overseas Bank group (UOB), will sell its UOL building by tender on May 6, real estate agent Edmund Tie & Co said on Monday.
It said in a statement the sale of the building just off the prime Orchard Road area was in line with UOL's plans to shift its investment emphasis to larger properties.
UOL building is a 16-storey commercial property with a total floor area of 7,608 sq metre (81,892 sq ft).
One property analyst said it would be worth about Singapore $160 million, or S$2,000 per sq ft, based on recent transactions of commercial buildings in the area.
